npc_han_01.text: Greetings, little friend. The Mortal Valley is usually peaceful, but these Spirit Bats are causing trouble. Can you help?

choices.text: I have other matters to attend to.

npc_han_accept.text: Excellent. Defeat 5 of them and I'll give you a Realm Token to travel further.

npc_mo_01.text: Cough... this old kotlík is falling apart! I need Iron Ore for my refinement. 10 pieces should do.

choices.text: I'll find the ore for you.

npc_mo_accept.text: Bless you! Bring me 10 Iron Ores and I'll grant you a Foundation Pill.

npc_shen_01.text: You stand before the Sword Saint. Only those with true resolve can cross the Inferno Battlefield. Prove your strength!

choices.text: I am ready for the trial.

npc_shen_accept.text: Then face the Inferno Guards! 10 of them must fall by your hand.

npc_wang_01.text: You have come far, child. The Nine Bridges are before you. One final trial remains before you can truly Trample the Heavens.

npc_wang_accept.text: Defeat 20 Heavenly Archers to prove your Dao. Go now.

stele_ning_qi.text: The stone hums with the energy of the first breath. You absorb a fragment of its ancient power.

stele_zhu_ji.text: This stele contains the secrets of Foundation. Your body feels heavier and more durable.

stele_jie_dan.text: A crimson glow emanates from the surface. Your spiritual power surges!

stele_final.text: 'Heaven is but a step, the Dao is the path.' You feel enlightened.

stele_yin.text: The Yin energy is cold and mysterious. It strengthens your internal foundation.

stele_yang.text: The Yang energy burns with fierce intensity. Your strength grows boundlessly!

npc_guardian_final.text: Stop, mortal! This is the Heavenly Reach. Only those who have conquered the nine heavens may pass.

npc_guardian_accept.text: Very well. Take the Void Gate Pill and face your destiny.
